Pressure Washing in Arlington Heights, IL

What's Included

Pressure washing strips years of dirt, algae, mold, mildew and oil stains off hard surfaces. On driveways we pre-treat, surface clean and post-treat with an eco-friendly solution so the concrete stays cleaner for longer. On siding we soft wash at low pressure, which cleans without damaging the surface.

  • Driveways and parking pads
  • Patios, walkways and steps
  • Decks (prepped for sealing or staining)
  • Low-pressure soft wash for house siding
  • Pressure and technique matched to each surface
